page.layout: Running head at top across the page: "RHETORICORUM LIB. II." with page number 659 at right. Two parallel columns of text: left column in Greek, with letter reference marks A, B, C, D, E, F set in the central gutter between the Greek and the Latin; right column in Latin. No marginal notes beyond the gutter letters. Below the right column: signature "tt ij" at the right foot. Faint mark at lower left (not printed text).

main_text.p: βούλονταί τι καὶ δύωνται· ὥστε ἐγγὺς εἶσι A τὸ ποιεῖν. καὶ ἀδικία δύναμιν ἔχουσα· πῶ τοῦ φοβεῖσθαι γὰρ ὁ ἄδικος, ἄδικος. καὶ ἀφεῖ τὴν ὑβρίζουσαν δύναμιν ἔχουσα· δῆλον γὰρ ὅτι φοβερεῖ τὴν ὑβρίζοντα, ἀεί, δύνασθαι δὲ νῦν. καὶ φόβος, τῆς δυναμένων π ποιῆσαι· ἐν παρασκευῇ γὰρ ἀνάγκη ἔχει καὶ τὸν τοιοῦτον. ἐπεὶ δὲ οἱ πολλοὶ χείρους καὶ ἥπιος τὰ κερδαίνειν, καὶ δεῖλοι ἐν τοῖς κινδύνοις φοβεῖσθαι ὡς ὅπο τοπολὺ, τὸ ἐαυ ἄλλῳ αὐτὸν εἶ.

Quare conscij ei, qui fecit aliquid atrox, metuendi, ne aut indicent aut deserant. Et qui possunt iniuriam facere, semper iis, qui possunt iniuriam pati. Nam plerunque iniuriam faciunt homines, quando possunt.
A ... Greek and Latin text continues in the columns as transcribed in full on the scan; the Greek column is printed in Greek letters throughout and only partially reproduced above.

page.notes: Greek column transcribed only in part; the remainder is legible on the scan but was not reproduced in full. Gutter letters A–F are reference marks. Latin column is continuous with the paragraphs shown above and continues to the foot of the page ("Necesse igitur est metuere eos," at the end). Some Greek words are doubtful and not marked individually; the text should be checked against the scan.
